$comment: Workspace rogueproof > Tools > MCP servers. The mock report registry from scenarios/registry: the benign MCP server MISSION.md asks the agent to use (decision 003), reached by the hosted gateway through the tunnel. No secret here: the URL and the authorization token are typed into the dashboard from .env (REGISTRY_PUBLIC_URL, REGISTRY_BEARER). serverId is the id the dashboard shows after saving; it is an identifier, not a credential, and also goes in .env as REGISTRY_MCP_SERVER_ID. null until registered: every run:* refuses to start until it is set.
name: registry
labelInResponses: the name: the `server` field of the mcp entry in otari_tool_calls reads `registry`.
purposeHint: Report registry for the RogueProof test scenario. Records the title and a short summary of a finished report.

rogueproof-fallback-test.$comment: The same server registered a second time, in the fallback-test workspace, for `pnpm run:safe --fallback-demo` (task 4.5, apply.md step 10). MCP servers are per workspace, so it has its own id there: paste it here and into .env as FALLBACK_TEST_REGISTRY_MCP_SERVER_ID. null means not registered yet, and the run refuses to start.

tools.submit_report: the only tool the gateway may offer the agent

attachedBy: mcp_server_ids on act turns only, next to the collector (packages/orchestrator/src/agent/tools.ts)
